programme.desc: Mengisahkan percintaan dan konflik antara Dira dan Rizal sehingga dia membawa dirinya ke Beijing. Takdir menemukan Dira dan cinta lamanya di Beijing secara tidak diduga.

programme.desc: Four college students who witness communal riots get imprisoned when they try to get justice for the victims. However, when a retired officer heads an inquiry commission, they join him in his efforts.

programme.title: Anjali
programme.desc: After a few years, Chitra learns that her child, who is believed to be dead, is alive but is suffering from a cognitive disorder. However, her family faces many challenges while raising the child.

programme.title: Pandavar Bhoomi
programme.desc: Dhanasekar hires an engineer, to rebuild his ancestral house. When he falls in love with Dhanasekar's niece, Dhanasekar narrates his family's past, which changes his mind to sacrifice his love.

programme.title: Kutti Puli
programme.desc: After losing her husband at a young age, Deivanai protects her son Puli so that he doesn't get embroiled in violence and village politics. Unfortunately, Puli follows his deceased father's footsteps.

programme.title: Good Luck
programme.desc: Surya, a carefree young man, lives in Malaysia with his brother and sister-in-law. He falls in love with Priya, a dancer, but problems arise when she learns that he has a daughter.

programme.title: Thondan
programme.desc: Jeeva, an uneducated driver, cannot tolerate child labour and fights to eliminate it. When Subha witnesses a murder and is in danger, Jeeva comes to her rescue.

programme.title: Tiger Viswa
programme.desc: After studying in the US, Vishwa starts living with his brother's family and gets into a tiff with two gangs. While the gangsters set out to get him, Vishwa's lover's marriage is fixed by her father.

programme.title: Thudikkum Karangal
programme.desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

programme.title: Kizhakku Vaasal
programme.desc: When an influential man from the village tries to molest Thaayamma, an orphan, she escapes from his clutches and is saved by Ponnurangam. Eventually, they fall in love.

programme.title: Gunaa
programme.desc: Guna, a mentally-disturbed man, imagines a fictitious character of a woman to be his future wife. One day, he sees a girl in a temple and assumes that she is his imaginary love and kidnaps her.

programme.title: Kathakali
